Vindexion eGRC Agent Demo: At a Glance

  • Vindexion's master eGRC platform ingests data gathered from its fleet of AI agents
  • The five agents in this demo are the first certified of a fleet being built for all 22 platform modules
  • Every agent runs inside a secure harness, with guardrails that block attacks and require human approval before any write
  • Anyone can ask an agent a plain-language question and get a verified answer, with the source records behind it
  • The agents pull from the systems an enterprise already runs, like applications, databases, and APIs
  • Each agent has one clear job, and every agent is tested before it is trusted
  • Four ideas hold it together: real results, lineage, secure guardrails, and an audit trail
  • This is a working prototype with synthetic data, and anything illustrative is labeled
  • If you only have a few minutes, start with the live agent run, then the blocked attack, then follow one figure through the lineage map to its approval and audit trail
